rich_narrative.summary:
The Islamic Scholarship Fund (ISF) empowers American Muslims by funding higher education and professional fellowships in public policy, media, and law. Founded in 2009, the organization addresses systemic underrepresentation of Muslim voices in American public discourse. In FY2024, ISF generated <cite id="3">$1,922,887 in total revenue</cite> to support its core mission. ISF holds <cite id="1">an overall rating of 91.7/100 from Charity Navigator</cite> and <cite id="1">meets all 20 BBB Wise Giving Alliance Standards for Charity Accountability</cite>.

ISF operates <cite id="2">a zakat-eligible fund</cite> targeting students qualifying under the fisabilillah category. In FY2024, the organization maintained <cite id="3">a program expense ratio of 71.8%</cite>, while spending <cite id="1">$0.19 to raise every dollar</cite>. Outcome data highlights an exceptional track record: <cite id="5">100% graduation rate among awardees</cite> and <cite id="5">88% of alumni working in their chosen field of study</cite>. With <cite id="5">over $3.67 million in cumulative awards granted</cite> since inception, ISF serves as a key pipeline for leadership development.
